battle.name: 唐朝與新羅的戰爭
battle.brief: 唐高宗時期，唐朝與新羅在平壤、熊津江一線由同盟轉為交戰，先平高句麗，再經百濟復國與唐羅對峙，最後新羅攻取平壤而唐軍北撤。這場戰爭的攻城與守城都靠直射重火力定型，羅馬弩砲所代表的一發一具箭的扭力擲弩，正是兩軍壓制城頭射手、掩護突擊的標準器械。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰方表面上只有兩個，實際經歷了三次翻轉。第一階段（670年）唐軍與新羅軍站在同一邊：唐以李勣為遼東道行軍大總管，領主力自遼東、幽州兩道分進，攻高句麗；新羅王眞平遣朴市田來金等率兵、馬、糧自海陸兩路參戰，策應高句麗南境，並準備接管百濟故地。高句麗以安市城為最後據點，由泉男生率精兵固守，唐將薛仁貴、張相如等圍城攻擊。第二階段（671至673年）形勢逆轉：新羅在唐軍主力北返後逐步接收百濟故地，扶餘隆在道林等百濟遺民簇擁下於熊津江流域復國建號，並得到新羅的默許；唐遣劉仁願實際統兵，契苾何力等率軍進剿，扶餘隆的復國運動遂成唐羅交惡的導火線。第三階段（675至676年）兩軍在熊津江兩岸正面交鋒：唐軍由劉仁願指揮，屯於熊津城南；新羅由眞平親領大軍，於熊津一役擊退唐軍前線，隨後北進攻取唐在百濟故地所置的州縣與平壤。最後唐朝承認既成事實，新羅由一個區域王國變成統一朝鮮半島的政權。
countriesEn: On the surface there were only two sides, but the conflict actually turned three times. In the first phase (670) the Tang and Silla armies stood on the same side: the Tang appointed Li Ji as Grand Commander of the Liaodong Circuit and drove its main forces along two axes out of Liaodong and Youzhou against Goguryeo, while King Jinpyeong of Silla sent commanders such as Pak Sijang Raegum with troops, horses and grain by both land and sea to support the southern approaches and to prepare for taking over the former territory of Baekje. Goguryeo held its last major base at Ansi City, defended by Naenmun with an elite garrison, and was besieged by Tang generals including Xue Rengui and Zhang Xiangru. In the second phase (671 to 673) the situation reversed: as the bulk of the Tang army withdrew northward, Silla took over the former Baekje lands, and Buyeo Pung, raised to kingship by Baekje remnant fighters such as Dongrim in the Kum River valley, was quietly tolerated by Silla; the Tang sent Liu Renyuan to take overall command, with Qibi Heli and others leading the punitive expedition, and the restoration of Buyeo Pung became the spark that set Tang against Silla. In the third phase (675 to 676) the two armies met face to face on both banks of the Kum River: the Tang under Liu Renyuan held the south side of the river near Kumjin, while Silla's army led by Jinpyeong in person broke the Tang front there and then drove north to take the Tang prefectures in the old Baekje territory and Pyongyang. In the end the Tang court accepted the fait accompli, and Silla turned from a regional kingdom into the ruler of the whole Korean peninsula.
people: 唐太宗李世民是整場戰爭的最初決策者：貞觀三年（669）他以高句麗未臣服、新羅已平百濟為由，決定再征東亞，於遼東、幽州兩道分兵，任李勣為遼東道行軍大總管。真正左右安市城攻防走向的是薛仁貴的臨陣機變：他築壘、插旗、擊鼓角，令遠處觀者以為援軍大至，使安市守將泉男生不敢出城，城中糧盡後泉男生出降，餘眾潰散，高句麗的最後抵抗就此瓦解。征東之後的善後由唐高宗李治接手，劉仁願奉命屯守百濟故地，契苾何力等契苾部將領隨軍助戰；這兩人在對新羅的戰線上既是防守的支撐，也是糾葛的來源——新羅眞平在百濟復國之戰中打敗唐軍，迫使唐軍一度收縮，劉仁願與契苾何力所部正是被分割的一方。新羅方面，眞平是唯一貫穿全程的統帥，他先遣朴市田來金等助唐攻高句麗，又在唐軍北返後接管百濟故地、迎擊唐軍，最終在熊津江一役迫使唐軍議和。扶餘隆是百濟復國運動的政治象徵：道林等百濟遺民以熊津江流域的山民部眾為基礎，於671年擁立他為王，渾等部將領率眾抵抗三年，至673年被平，這場戰役暴露了唐在百濟故地統治的脆弱。
peopleEn: Tang Taizong Li Shimin was the man who set the whole war in motion: in 669, the third year of Zhenguan, he judged that Goguryeo had still not submitted and that Silla had been left too strong after the fall of Baekje, and so decided to renew the campaign in the east, splitting his armies between the Liaodong and Youzhou circuits and naming Li Ji Grand Commander of the Liaodong Circuit. What decided the course of the siege of Ansi City was Xue Rengui's opportunism on the spot: he raised earthen ramparts, planted banners, and beat drums and horns so that watchers in the distance believed a great relief army had arrived, and the garrison commander Naenmun dared not leave the city; when the grain ran out Naenmun came out and surrendered, the rest of the garrison broke up, and the last resistance of Goguryeo collapsed. The aftermath of the eastern campaign fell to Tang Gaozong Li Zhi, who ordered Liu Renyuan to garrison the old Baekje lands, with Qibi Heli and other Khitan commanders serving with the army. On the Silla front these two were both the prop of the defence and the source of the embarrassment, because Jinpyeong of Silla defeated Tang troops during the war against the Baekje restoration and forced the Tang to pull back, and the troops of Liu Renyuan and Qibi Heli were the ones cut off. On the Silla side Jinpyeong is the only commander present throughout: he first sent Pak Sijang Raegum and others to help the Tang destroy Goguryeo, then took over the former Baekje lands once the Tang main force had gone north, met the Tang army head on, and finally forced a negotiated settlement at the Kum River in 675. Buyeo Pung was the political symbol of the Baekje restoration: Dongrim and other Baekje remnants built on the mountain communities of the Kum River valley, raised him to kingship in 671, and leaders such as Hun held out for three years until the movement was crushed in 673. The campaign exposed how thin the Tang hold on the old Baekje territory really was.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是羅馬弩砲（scorpio）：以扭力儲能的鋼弦機件蓄力，一發一具箭，箭身如短矛、後端加配重，屬羅馬軍用直射重火力，主要用於壓制城頭與掩體後的目標，射程約在數百步。它同時是一件技術史的樣本——羅馬人用它拆掉希臘城牆，而東亞在六至七世紀也發展出功能相近的弩砲（床弩、車弩），唐人《太白陰經》所記的弩砲張機需百餘人，矢及數百步，可用於攻城破門與城頭攔擊。唐軍東征的攻城體系由雲梯、火箭、撞車、穴地與帶砲壘配合而成：安市城地勢險固、依山傍水，唐軍先以穴地法掘進城根，試圖截斷城內水源，再用拋石與火器清空城頭，最後由薛仁貴以疑兵迫其出降，弩砲這類直射器械即部署在營壘四周與攻城列陣的兩翼，專打城頭暴露的射手。新羅軍的攻城手段同樣完整：自671年百濟復國起，新羅在唐所設州縣外圍用雲梯、撞車與弩砲試圖破城；675年熊津江之戰，新羅以步兵密集隊形沿江推進，弓弩與弩砲在陣前覆蓋唐軍前線，逼唐騎兵展開，再以主力楔入唐軍側翼，擊潰契苾何力所部騎兵。值得注意的是，弩砲在這場戰爭裏的真正價值不在攻城，而在城防：唐軍在百濟故地的州縣城頭固定配置弩砲與床弩，新羅攻城必須先把這些直射火器壓住，而唐代兵器制度中城防器械的配備比例，往往決定一座州縣能守多久。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Roman scorpio: a machine that stores energy in twisted skeins of sinew or steel, firing one heavy bolt at a time, the shaft shaped like a short spear with added weight at the rear. It belonged to the Roman repertoire of direct heavy firepower, used mainly to pin down defenders on the walls and behind cover, with a range of several hundred paces. It is also a specimen of technical history, since the Romans used it to break down Greek walls, while East Asia in the sixth and seventh centuries developed machinery of comparable function, the nu pao or bed and cart crossbows recorded in Tang military manuals; the Tang text Tai Bai Yin Jing notes that such a machine needed more than a hundred men to cock and could shoot several hundred paces, making it usable both for breaching walls and for covering the parapet during a siege. The Tang eastern expedition combined scaling ladders, fire arrows, battering rams, mine tunnels and protected gun emplacements, for Ansi City was steeply sited and sat by the water: the army first drove tunnels toward the foot of the wall to cut the water supply inside, then used stone throwers and incendiaries to clear the parapet, and finally Xue Rengui's feint brought the surrender. Direct-firing machines of the scorpio type were posted around the camps and on the flanks of the assault lines, picking off the exposed defenders on the walls. The Silla siege train was equally complete: from the restoration of Baekje in 671, Silla worked at the Tang prefectural towns with ladders, rams and bolt throwers; at the battle on the Kum River in 675 the Silla infantry advanced in dense columns along the river, archers and bolt throwers covered the Tang front and forced the Tang cavalry to deploy, and then the main body wedged into the Tang flank, breaking Qibi Heli's horsemen. What matters most, though, is that the value of the scorpio in this war lay less in siege work than in fixed defence: the Tang mounted bolt throwers and bed crossbows on the towers of the prefectural towns in the old Baekje territory, and any Silla assault had to silence that direct fire first, so the proportion of heavy defensive machines in the Tang arms regulations often decided how long a walled town could hold out.
tactics: 唐軍在貞觀三年至四年之間的東征分兩路：主力由李勣領遼東道行軍大總管之眾，取營州、遼東方向正面推向平壤；幽州一線由張相如等部東進，攻安市城。攻城戰分三段：先以大軍列陣城下，以床弩與弩砲封鎖城門與城頭射界；再以穴地法掘進城根，試圖截斷城內水源，並以火箭焚燒糧秣與城頭建物；最後環城築壘，築土堆、插旗幟、擊鼓角，令遠望如援軍大至，迫敵人不敢出戰。安市城守軍夜襲唐營，唐軍雖有失利仍合圍不退，最終以糧盡援絕出降。唐羅直接交鋒時，劉仁願的部署重心是守住漢江與熊津江下游的交通線與渡口，倚託既設州縣城固守，把唐軍主力壓在江南的有限縱深裡；新羅則以步兵密集隊形沿江推進，先以弓弩與弩砲在陣前覆蓋唐軍前線，迫唐騎兵展開失去衝鋒的空間，再以主力楔入唐軍側翼，使契苾何力部騎兵崩潰。675年（唐上元二年）夏，雙方在熊津城南接觸，最終各遣代表於石城村歃血為盟，劃地而處，唐軍退回熊津以北。676年新羅轉守為攻，沿唐軍放棄的驛道與糧道北上，逐一攻取唐在百濟故地所置的州縣城池與平壤，每下一城即遷置官吏、按戶編籍，把軍事勝利轉成行政佔領。
tacticsEn: The Tang eastern campaign of the third and fourth years of Zhenguan was divided into two axes: the main body, commanded by Li Ji as Grand Commander of the Liaodong Circuit, pushed straight down the Yingzhou and Liaodong line toward Pyongyang, while a second force under Zhang Xiangru advanced east from Youzhou against Ansi City. The siege was fought in three stages. First the massed army was arrayed beneath the walls, bed crossbows and bolt throwers sealing the gates and every firing line on the parapet. Then sappers drove mines toward the foot of the wall in an attempt to cut the water supply inside the city, while incendiaries were used to burn grain stacks and the wooden structures of the defences. Finally the army built a ring of fortifications around the city, heaping up earth, planting banners and beating drums and horns so that the enemy looking out saw what seemed a huge relief force, which deterred any sortie. The Goguryeo garrison raided the Tang camp at night and the Tang suffered a reverse, yet they did not lift the siege, and the city finally surrendered when grain and relief ran out. When Tang and Silla came to direct blows, Liu Renyuan based his deployment on holding the lines of communication and the ferry points down the Han and Kum rivers, relying on the fortified prefectural towns already established, and keeping the Tang army compressed into the narrow depth south of the river. Silla advanced in dense infantry columns along the river, covered the Tang front with bows and bolt throwers, forced the Tang cavalry to deploy and lose the room for a charge, and then wedged the main body into the Tang flank, which caused Qibi Heli's mounted troops to collapse. In the summer of 675, the second year of Shangyuan, the two sides made contact south of Kumjin and finally sent representatives to the village of Seokseong, where they swore a blood oath, fixed a boundary, and the Tang withdrew north of the Kum River. In 676 Silla turned from defence to attack, moving north along the post roads and supply lines the Tang had abandoned, taking the Tang prefectural towns in the old Baekje territory one by one and then Pyongyang, and in every place it installed officials and registered households, converting a military victory into an administrative occupation.
data: 兵力與編制方面，唐軍在669年十一月出師時，通鑑所記為「率兵十餘萬眾」，分遼東道（李勣）、齊州道（李道宗）與幽州道（張相如）三路；高句麗方面，安市城守軍由泉男生率精兵十餘萬拒守。新羅助唐的兵員數目史無明載，一般認為以萬計，並出馬匹與糧秣接濟。時間上，669年出師到670年八月薛仁貴破安市城，前後約十個月；670年九月高句麗諸城相繼歸降，唐於其地置安東都督府，收其戶口。百濟復國運動自671年扶餘隆即位起，到673年被平，約三年，其中唐軍進剿的重心在熊津江與漢江下游的城邑。675年唐羅在熊津城南歃血為盟後，兩軍對峙約一年，676年新羅北進才打破僵局。器械數據方面，羅馬弩砲的箭矢長約半米，重數百克至一公斤上下，射程約數百步；唐人《太白陰經》所記床弩（弩砲）張機需百餘人，矢及七百步，說明這類直射重火力在東亞的運作規模遠大於羅馬。地理上，平壤與熊津相距約數百里，其間為山嶺與河谷縱橫的地形，適合守方以城塞分割進攻方，而不利於一次會戰定勝負。
dataEn: On troops and organisation, the Tang army set out in the eleventh month of 669, and the Zizhi Tongjian records that it went out with more than a hundred thousand men, split into three axes: the Liaodong Circuit under Li Ji, the Qizhou Circuit under Li Daozong, and the Youzhou Circuit under Zhang Xiangru. On the Goguryeo side, the garrison of Ansi City under Naenmun counted more than a hundred thousand picked men. The size of the Silla contingent sent to help the Tang is not recorded precisely; it is generally taken to run into the thousands of men, with horses and grain supplied as well. In time, the expedition left in 669 and Ansi City fell to Xue Rengui in the eighth month of 670, so the eastern campaign took about ten months; in the ninth month the remaining Goguryeo cities surrendered one after another and the Tang set up the Andong Protectorate over the country, registering its households. The Baekje restoration lasted from the enthronement of Buyeo Pung in 671 to its suppression in 673, roughly three years, with the Tang counter-offensive concentrated on the towns along the Kum and lower Han rivers. After the blood oath south of Kumjin in 675 the two armies faced each other for about a year before Silla's northward drive in 676 broke the stalemate. As for the machines, a Roman scorpio bolt was roughly half a metre long and weighed on the order of several hundred grams to a kilogram, with a range of several hundred paces, while the bed crossbow recorded in the Tang text Tai Bai Yin Jing needed more than a hundred men to cock and reached seven hundred paces, which shows how much larger the operating scale of this kind of direct heavy fire was in East Asia than in the Roman world. Geographically, Pyongyang and Kumjin lie several hundred li apart, separated by mountains and river valleys, a landscape that suited a defending side using fortified towns to break up an attacker's advance and made a single decisive battle unlikely.
cause: 戰爭的起因有兩層。第一層是唐與高句麗的宿怨：隋朝三征高句麗皆告失敗，士卒疲敝、天下多故，高句麗成了隋的傷口；唐太宗既不能容忍高句麗拒不臣服，也不願讓新羅獨強，於是669年再興東征，並把新羅拉進同盟，用它的兵馬分擔沿海與山區的進攻。第二層是同盟破裂：新羅在唐軍攻下高句麗、平壤之後，急於把勢力伸入百濟故地與高句麗舊域；而唐朝視平壤與漢江流域為可以直接編戶齊民的帝國邊疆，於670年前後設安東都督府等機構，派劉仁願屯兵並接收戶籍，試圖長期佔領。670年高句麗平滅之後，新羅拿到的只是空殼府縣，實際控制權在唐軍與流散百濟遺民手中；671年扶餘隆在道林等遺民簇擁下於熊津江流域復國，立即得到新羅的支持或默許，因為新羅需要一個百濟國來替自己擋住唐軍。結果唐軍要剿滅的扶餘隆勢力，恰恰是新羅最自然的盟友。更深的原因是體制上的：唐軍的邊疆治理模式是郡縣化、編戶齊民，需要和平與穩定稅賦；新羅的國家目標則是統一三國舊地，必然要把唐的郡縣機構與駐軍逐出半島。676年新羅大舉攻唐所置州縣，不是偶發衝突，而是這一結構矛盾的一次總爆發。
causeEn: The war had two layers of cause. The first was the old grudge between Tang and Goguryeo: the three Sui campaigns against Goguryeo had all failed, leaving the Sui armies exhausted and the realm troubled, and Goguryeo remained an open wound. Tang Taizong could tolerate neither a Goguryeo that refused to submit nor a Silla grown too strong on its own, so he launched a new eastern campaign in 669 and pulled Silla into the alliance, using its troops to share the burden of advancing along the coast and through the mountains. The second layer was the rupture of that alliance. Once the Tang had taken Goguryeo and Pyongyang, Silla rushed to extend its power into the old Baekje lands and the former Goguryeo territory, while the Tang court regarded Pyongyang and the Han River valley as a frontier district of the empire that could be administered directly: it set up offices such as the Andong Protectorate around 670, posted troops under Liu Renyuan and took over the registers, intending to hold the territory for good. After Goguryeo fell in 670, what Silla received was a hollow administrative shell whose real control lay with the Tang garrisons and the scattered Baekje remnant. In 671 Buyeo Pung was raised to kingship in the Kum River valley by Dongrim and other remnants, and this was tolerated, even supported, by Silla, because Silla needed a restored Baekje to stand between itself and the Tang army. The force the Tang set out to destroy was thus precisely the natural ally of Silla. Deeper still lay a difference of system: the Tang model of frontier government was county administration and household registration, which needed peace and steady tax revenue, whereas Silla's national goal was the unification of the three old kingdoms, which required the Tang's county offices and garrisons to be pushed off the peninsula. The Silla offensive of 676 against the Tang prefectures was not an accidental clash but the general eruption of that structural contradiction.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接結果，是新羅成為半島唯一的政權，而唐朝放棄了自669年出師以來經營近十年的東亞邊疆。第一，軍事格局改變：660年唐羅聯手滅百濟，668年李勣攻陷平壤，669至670年再平安市城，高句麗這個自兩晉以來最大的東北亞政權之一在三年之內覆滅，其民眾或降唐、或逃入山區，成為三韓地區人口的構成部分之一。第二，戰爭模式轉移：從唐羅同盟的北進共討，轉為唐羅對抗的邊界角力，最終以新羅攻取平壤、完成三國統一、唐朝承認既成事實收場，唐的東亞經營退回到以使節、冊封與物資往來維持的名義宗主關係。第三，制度與工藝層面：新羅在唐軍留下的府縣、驛道、寺廟、錢幣與瓦當之上大量鑄造自己的仿唐器物，形成吸收唐制度的第二波高峰；而弩砲這類扭力直射重火力在東亞的落地，說明七世紀的東亞並非封閉，六至七世紀之間地中海與東亞的技術譜系有交會的痕跡。第四，歷史書寫的分裂：唐方記錄把這場衝突寫成平定百濟遺亂的邊征，新羅記錄則寫成統一三國的聖戰；同一批戰役，兩份檔案給出完全相反的道德方向，這也是唐羅之間難以重建信任的根源。
impactEn: The direct outcome of this war was that Silla became the single authority on the peninsula while the Tang gave up a frontier position they had been building for close to a decade since the army marched out in 669. First, the military balance changed: in 660 Tang and Silla together destroyed Baekje, in 668 Li Ji took Pyongyang, and between 669 and 670 Ansi City fell, so that Goguryeo, one of the largest states in Northeast Asia since the Two Jin, was extinguished within three years, its people either submitting to the Tang or fleeing into the hills and becoming one of the sources of the peninsula's population. Second, the mode of war shifted: from a joint northern campaign to a border contest between Tang and Silla, and the war ended with Silla taking Pyongyang, completing the unification of the three kingdoms, while the Tang accepted the fait accompli and fell back on a nominal suzerainty maintained through envoys, investiture and the exchange of goods. Third, at the level of institutions and craft, Silla built a second wave of Tang imitation on top of the offices, post roads, temples, coins and roof tiles left behind by the Tang army, and the arrival in East Asia of direct heavy firepower of the torsion bolt-thrower type shows that seventh-century East Asia was not sealed off: the technical lineages of the Mediterranean and of East Asia did cross paths in these centuries. Fourth, the record itself split apart: the Tang sources wrote the conflict as a frontier campaign to suppress a Baekje revolt, while the Silla sources wrote it as the holy war that unified the three kingdoms. The same set of battles receives opposite moral directions in the two archives, and that divergence is the root of the lasting distrust between Tang and Silla.
result: 打完了：新羅拿下百濟與高句麗故地，唐朝退守遼東。676年（上元三年）春，新羅出兵攻取唐在百濟故地所置的州縣城邑，唐遣使臣前往責問，新羅上表謝罪並請還所侵之地，兩國在沒有再打一場大規模會戰的情況下達成協議，唐朝承認新羅對百濟、高句麗舊域的佔有，實質分界退到鴨綠水一線。九月，新羅軍進佔平壤，高句麗故地最後的抵抗力量瓦解，朝鮮半島三國時代結束，海上新羅同時面對百濟遺民、倭國與唐朝三個方向。對唐而言，這是一筆可以接受的交易：放棄朝鮮半島的郡縣化，退而改以冊封與使節維持宗主的名分，避免了在半島上再投入十萬大軍。對新羅而言，這是一場徹底的戰略勝利：它以百濟復國運動為槓桿，消耗唐軍於內陸，最後自己出手取地，完成了統一三國的目標，也避開了與唐軍再做一場玉石俱焚的正面決戰。整場戰爭最具決定性的一手，是新羅始終把唐羅同盟的剩餘價值用到最後：先借唐軍之力滅高句麗，再借百濟復國拖住唐軍，最後才自己出手。羅馬弩砲在這場戰爭裏只是一個象徵，它代表的是從地中海傳到東亞的一條攻城技術譜系；而真正在半島上決定歸屬的，是誰能把外來裝備與本地人力結合起來。
resultEn: It was over: Silla took the old lands of Baekje and Goguryeo, and the Tang withdrew to guard Liaodong. In the spring of 676, the third year of Shangyuan, Silla troops attacked and took the Tang prefectural towns in the former Baekje territory; the Tang sent envoys to protest, Silla presented a memorial of apology and offered to give back what it had taken, and the two states reached an understanding without another large-scale battle, with the Tang recognising Silla's possession of the old Baekje and Goguryeo lands and the effective frontier pushed back to the Yalu River. In the ninth month Silla forces entered Pyongyang, the last resistance in the former Goguryeo territory collapsed, the Three Kingdoms period of the peninsula ended, and the maritime power of Silla now faced three directions at once: the Baekje remnants, the Japanese state across the sea, and the Tang. For the Tang this was an acceptable bargain, giving up county administration on the peninsula and falling back on investiture and envoys to keep the appearance of suzerainty, instead of committing another hundred thousand men to the peninsula. For Silla it was a complete strategic victory: with the Baekje restoration as a lever it wore the Tang army down in the interior, then took the land itself, achieving the unification of the three kingdoms and avoiding a second mutually ruinous frontal battle with the Tang army. The decisive move of the whole war was that Silla kept spending the residual value of the Tang-Silla alliance to the last: borrowing Tang strength to destroy Goguryeo, then borrowing the Baekje restoration to pin the Tang down, and only then striking for the land. The Roman scorpio in this war is only a symbol; it stands for a line of siegecraft technology that ran from the Mediterranean to East Asia. What actually decided ownership on the peninsula was who could marry imported equipment to local manpower.
